notes: Two isnads joined by «ح» with no convergence marker: no shared tail. The first ends at «أبي» (Mu'adh's father, not named again); the second writes its own names
«ولم يذكر ابن المثنى النضر بن أنس» is a remark naming another transmitter: a variant
«بإسناده» is a back reference, written as the last link of the second route
